title: Three D2C brands, one loop: what changed
hook: Same loop, three categories, three different winning patterns.
caption:
Same loop, three categories, three different winning patterns.

Fashion: the win came from what held attention. +67% RoAS, and $3,800 moved to better ads in month one.
Beauty: hooks. A 3× hook rate, +112% RoAS and 30% less wasted spend.
Wellness: real over aspirational. A 2.6× uplift and +91% RoAS.

No magic. Just knowing which part of each ad did the work, and acting on it every two weeks.

All results are anonymised and published on galvor.ai. Link in bio.
